newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan stocks close higher on short-covering.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan stocks close higher on short-covering.

text.p: Pakistan stocks closed higher on Tuesday on short-covering ahead of a four-day holiday, dealers said. The market will reopen on Sunday.
The Karachi Stock Exchange 100-share index closed 5.00 points, or 0.36 percent, higher at 1,377.40, after rising to 1,379.65. Losers led gainers 144 to 98.

Short-covering before the holiday pushed the index up, dealer Asif Janmohammad said. Dewan Salman rose 1.70 rupees to 30.45, HUBCO 0.50 to 32.45, PTCL 0.30 to 27.20, PSO 1.00 to 263 and ICI Pakistan 0.60 to 18.35. -- Ibrahim Khan 9221-5685192
